subject: Re: Hosted API per-token structure — concession path and example math
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acerohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API per-token structure — initial concession path & math

Maria —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I pulled together a simple concession path for a 12-month hosted-API commitment so Acero can see marginal vs blended outcomes under realistic consumption profiles. Attached is an initial token-breakdown workbook (acero_token_breakdown_v1.xlsx). High level: 

- Baseline ask: 6M tokens/month committed (12-month term).
- Proposed breakpoints (marginal ladder): Tier A 0-3M @ $0.0008/token, Tier B 3M-8M @ $0.00065/token, Tier C 8M+ @ $0.0005/token.
- Blended example: for budgeting we can quote an effective blended rate based on forecasted mix; sample blended at 6M/month = $0.0007/token.

What I want to surface next: you mentioned Acero prefers a blended rate for forecasting, but procurement also asked about true-up mechanics and potential clawbacks if actual usage falls materially below commit. The workbook includes: a) marginal worked examples, b) blended effective-rate calculations, and c) a simple true-up approach (monthly measurement + quarterly settlement with a 10% tolerance band and a one-time contract credit for shortfalls beyond that).

Ask: Can you confirm whether Acero prefers monthly or quarterly true-ups, and whether you need the blended number to be fixed in the master agreement (we can lock a guaranteed blended floor for budgeting with a separate reconciliation table)?

If useful I can run two quick scenarios next: a conservative blended quote for finance (for forecast) and an aggressive marginal-first structure for Procurement to review.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to walk through the workbook.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Attachment: acero_token_breakdown_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acerohealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API per-token structure — initial concession path & math

Vanessa —

Thanks for the detailed note and workbook. A few quick clarifying questions from Procurement and Finance: 

1) For budgeting purposes our FP&A team wants a single blended number in the PO. They dislike a marginal ladder unless we include clear examples showing the blended outcome under different usage mixes.
2) True-up cadence: Procurement is leaning toward monthly reconciliation with a 30-day invoice adjustment window. Are you able to support monthly true-ups operationally?
3) Clawbacks: Finance will accept a one-time annual reconciliation but wants a cap (we suggested a 15% cap on any clawback charge).

Separately, security has a short list of baseline items (SOC 2 attestation + data retention policy). We can share the security questionnaire but want to see the final financial construct first.

Procurement timeline: we aim to get a PO and SOW in place by end of August if numbers work.

Would you be able to provide two lines in writing: (A) a blended budget rate for a 6M/mo forecast locked for the first 6 months and (B) the marginal ladder calculations with a worked example for 6M and 10M usage so FP&A can validate?

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Director, Strategic Sourcing — AceroHealth
procurement@acerohealth.com
Attachment: Acero_PO_timeline.pdf (procurement outline)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acerohealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API per-token structure — initial concession path & math

Maria — thanks — looping in Logan (Finance/GT) and Marissa (Solutions) to keep everyone aligned. Below are the two deliverables you requested inline; I also attached an updated workbook with both scenario tabs (acero_token_breakdown_v2.xlsx).

A) Blended budget rate (locked for first 6 months):
- Forecast: 6,000,000 tokens/month = 72,000,000 tokens/year.
- We can offer a locked blended rate of $0.00068/token for months 1–6 with a quarterly review at month 3 to confirm usage banding. This gives you a predictable budget line for FP&A.

B) Marginal ladder worked examples (numbers below use the ladder from the original file):
- Ladder: 0–3M @ $0.0008; 3M–8M @ $0.00065; 8M+ @ $0.0005.
- Example (6M month): cost = (3M * 0.0008) + (3M * 0.00065) = $2,400 + $1,950 = $4,350 => effective/blended = 4,350 / 6,000,000 = $0.000725/token.
- Example (10M month): cost = (3M * 0.0008) + (5M * 0.00065) + (2M * 0.0005) = 2,400 + 3,250 + 1,000 = $6,650 => effective/blended = 6,650 / 10,000,000 = $0.000665/token.

Notes on true-up & clawback:
- Operationally we support monthly measurements and monthly adjustments. Monthly true-up requires setting a tolerance band to avoid churning small variances; proposal: 10% tolerance band for monthly, with any cumulative shortfall beyond 10% subject to quarterly settlement.
- Clawback cap: Redwood is comfortable with a 15% cap on annual clawbacks for this size of commitment; clawback is calculated on the delta between billed blended commitments and realized marginal calculation.

Next steps I propose: confirm the 6-month locked blended at $0.00068/token and monthly true-ups with a 10% tolerance band and 15% annual clawback cap. If that tracks, we can convert the workbook into an SOW line item and route to Legal for a simple addendum.

Link to HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ACERO-2027-0810
DocuSign (SOW stub): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=abcdef1234567890

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: acero_token_breakdown_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: approval for blended lock + clawback cap

Team — quick internal note before we send the formal SOW: Finance OKayed the 6-month blended lock at $0.00068/token as a short-term concession but asked we build guardrails into the SOW: 

- Blended lock applies only to months 1–6; month 7 onward reverts to marginal ladder unless the customer converts to a multi-year committed rate.
- Monthly true-ups supported, but settlements occur quarterly to minimize invoice churn (we'll net monthly variances into a quarterly invoice).
- Clawback operationalization: annual reconciliation with a maximum charge equal to 15% of the committed spend for the year (not of total usage).
- Approve SOW: include a short example table and the token workbook as an exhibit; attach SOW draft for Legal pre-review.

I'm attaching the short SOW draft (SOW-draft-acero.pdf). Please confirm and I will route to Legal with the finance bullet points.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Group Finance Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW-draft-acero.pdf (draft)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acerohealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acerohealth.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Hosted API per-token structure — concession path and example math

Vanessa / Team —

We reviewed the blended lock and marginal examples internally with FP&A and Security. Acero is prepared to proceed with the following conditions: 

1) Accept the 6-month locked blended rate at $0.00068/token.
2) We will run monthly true-ups (measure monthly), with financial settlement quarterly per Redwood's proposed netting approach.
3) Clawback: we accept the 15% annual cap as described, but we need the language limiting it to committed spend to be explicit in the SOW.
4) Security: SOC 2 Type II report and data retention Appendix required prior to PO execution.

If you can update the SOW exhibit to reflect the explicit clawback calculation and attach the SOC 2 summary, we will route to Legal and Procurement and should be able to return a signed PO by 2027-08-24.

Please route the revised SOW to legal@acerohealth.com and procurement@acerohealth.com.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Director, Strategic Sourcing — AceroHealth
